_help: Key settings window (UI/StatusBar3.img/KeyConfig art). x/y = the window spot in 1366x768 game pixels, w/h = the window size (it must match the art). titleH = the title strip height. kbX/kbY = the official keyboard art (backgrnd3) spot. keyW/keyH = one key box on the official keyPos grid, keyDx/keyDy = the box offset from the official spot. grid* = the official cell grid under the keyboard (the art draws the cells, the actions sit in the first ones): gridX/gridY = the first cell, gridCols = the cells per row, cellW/cellH = the cell size, cellPitchX/cellPitchY = the cell step. custom*/copy*/apply*/pg1*/pg2*/pg3*/cancel*/reset*/save*/close* = the buttons.
